author: Bobby Grayson
description: Uniq : List (k x v) -> Prop is structural (nil => True; kv :: rest => (forall x in rest, x.1 != kv.1 and x.2 != kv.2) and Uniq rest). uniq_cons is the Iff.rfl unfolding, needed because Uniq is a def by pattern match: rw [insert]/rw [erase] first, then uniq_cons.mpr. key_inj/val_inj need no DecidableEq (omit). insert_fresh takes 'forall x in m, x.2 != v'. Also new: Leanactors/Term.lean (structure Term where id : Nat, DecidableEq, Repr) with Term.fresh, id_mk, mk_inj, mk_injective, mk_ne_of_lt, ne_of_id_ne
title: GENERIC LEMMAS added to Leanactors/AssocList.lean (wf6/untyped): AssocList.mem_erase_of_ne, AssocList.Uniq (def: no two entries share a key, no two share a value), uniq_nil, uniq_cons, Uniq.key_inj, Uniq.val_inj, Uniq.insert_fresh, Uniq.erase. Reuse these instead of re-proving
